notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).  DEDI 2026-09-22 (run map05, after the mount fix): the map now LOADS and spawns a server (`------ Server Initialization ------ / Server: mw2rust`), then dies with a GSC runtime error and the server shuts down. `undefined is not an array, string, or vector` at `common_scripts/utility.gsc:463 while( !level.flag[ msg ] )`, from `maps/mw2rust.gsc:179 flag_wait("electricity_on")` reached through `common_scripts/utility.gsc:586 entities[keys[i]] thread [[process]]()`, from `maps/mw2rust.gsc:119 array_thread(end_trig, ::end_game)`. `level.flag` is created by `maps/_load.gsc:97`'s `flag_init("all_players_connected")`, so a map-provided script is flag_waiting before `_load::main()` has run. NOT ours: we mount no overlay (fs_game is the map's own mod, the referee is C++ and ships nothing inside it), the console shows `Loading fastfile 'mod'` and the map fastfile loading, and Der Berg answers getstatus with the same mount. Why the same script survives on a listen server is NOT established. dedi.md 13.3, referee.md 10. DEDI/REFEREE 2026-09-22 (runs mapA/mapB/mapC, join80-join83): THE 'broken' VERDICT IS CONFIRMED AND THE BLAME IS CORRECTED. The previous session left open whether our dedicated server, a referee GSC overlay or the replay sampler was the shared cause. It is none of them, and that was settled by running the maps with ours REMOVED rather than by reading code. dedi.md 14, referee.md 11. Run mapA booted this map on a STOCK CoDWaW.exe -- binkw32 proxy reverted, ZERO ENW code in the process -- as a LISTEN server, and it produced the byte-identical script runtime error. The cause is the map's own script order: main() starts a flag-dependent thread BEFORE it calls maps\_zombiemode::main(), which is what calls maps\_load::main(), which is where flag_init("all_players_connected") lives. A GSC `thread` begins executing immediately and flag_wait's first act is to index level.flag, so it faults before anything can have created the array. WHY THE COMMUNITY PLAYS IT ANYWAY IS NOT ESTABLISHED, and is written down as unestablished; the likeliest answer is that the archived download is a repack. Nothing in this lane can fix it. status stays "broken". From mw2rust.iwd: main() does array_thread(end_trig, ::end_game) at line 119 and maps\_zombiemode::main() at line 122; end_game() reaches flag_wait("electricity_on") at line 179.  ARCHIVE 2026-09-23 (runs addon5 baseline / addon6 / addon7, dedicated, seeded private localappdata): THE ADD-ON-IWD THEORY IS TESTED AND DEAD. Run addon6, both add-ons excluded: the SAME `flag_wait("electricity_on")` at maps/mw2rust.gsc:179, which is the MAP'S OWN line and carries the map author's own comment `//remove line if you want it to work without power`. The add-ons are not the cause. dedi.md 15.
